tests.name: production tab is reachable from the UI; loads clean; no external request; honest no-provider note; RTL
i18n parity holds with the new keys; English switches to LTR with translated production UI
Arabic and English full-production/SaaS requests activate; an ordinary project does not; the explicit flag activates but skips nothing
GUIDED shows no engineering jargon; ASSISTED shows the engineering term beside plain text; EXPERT shows ids and all questions
E2E: idea -> discovery -> recommendations -> human confirmations -> readiness -> guardian clear -> package -> attachment -> approval
changing a confirmed decision after approval shows the impact first, then invalidates the approval and reopens dependents
conflict between two confirmed decisions is detected, blocks approval, and is resolved by changing one of them
reject, reopen, defer-with-condition, not-applicable and bad input are all handled; defer without a condition is refused
the guardian cannot be bypassed by editing the UI: enabling the approve button changes nothing
tampering with the stored production ledger is detected on reopen and editing is blocked
Factory cannot execute the chosen architecture: reported with the gap and the user's choices, nothing substituted
AI-native SaaS with no provider: everything still works; AI dimension appears; model admission is never claimed
missing critical production evidence is shown honestly: every applicable claim is EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and lists the evidence kinds
every required document is viewable and downloadable; exports are valid JSON bound to the shown hashes
empty and error states: documents without a base package, readiness/guardian/execution without activation
XSS and prompt-injection text in the intent and manual answers is inert data: no script runs, nothing is auto-confirmed
no secret/credential is written to storage or to exports
mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, tabs and confirm/approve controls visible and >=44px, both directions
keyboard: the whole discovery/confirm flow works without a mouse and focus is retained on the acted card
accessibility basics: every form control has an accessible name; live regions and landmarks exist; tablist semantics
D1: a stored attachment edited to look CLEAR (hash recomputed) with a self-made approval is NOT shown as approved
D2: the exported attachment states its own status, so a superseded approval cannot be mistaken for a valid one
D3: the base technology question offers «لا أعرف، اقترح الأنسب»; the suggestion is pending until the HUMAN confirms; Factory admission stays separate
D3: a phone-app answer yields the mobile suggestion; the human can reject it and answer manually
local-approval disclosure is shown beside the package and execution-approval status, AR/EN, desktop and 390px, without overflow
R1: original app title wraps (no clipping, no horizontal overflow) at 390px in RTL and LTR even with a wide fallback font, and desktop is unchanged
